question: Chethiyagiri Vihara Festival is organised in which state?
solution:
The correct answer is **Madhya Pradesh**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Chethiyagiri Vihara Festival** is a significant cultural and religious event.
 
• It is primarily celebrated in the state of **Madhya Pradesh**.
 
• The festival is held at the **Chethiyagiri Vihara**, a notable Buddhist monastery.
 
• **Devotees and tourists** from various parts of the country visit to participate in the celebrations.
 
• The festival includes **rituals, prayers, and cultural performances** that highlight the rich heritage of Buddhism.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 Aspect
 Description
 
 
 
 

 **Location**
 The Chethiyagiri Vihara is located in **Sanchi**, Madhya Pradesh.
 
 

 **Historical Significance**
 Sanchi is renowned for its **Buddhist stupas** and is a **UNESCO World Heritage Site**.
 
 

 **Cultural Impact**
 The festival helps in promoting the **Buddhist cultural heritage** and attracting **tourism**.
 
 

 **Activities**
 Includes **meditation sessions**, **chanting of sutras**, and **community feasts**.
 
 

 **Visitors**
 Attracts **Buddhist monks**, **scholars**, and **tourists** from around the world.
